veranderings.rede: The second half ('die meeste diere en plante op land ook nie') has no verb of its own, so under the AWS 2017 house rule no comma goes before 'en'; the protected wording stays intact.
The 'maar' half ('gewoonlik te min om dit te proe') has no subject and verb of its own, so under the AWS 2017 house rule it takes no comma.

vlae.teks: Water verdamp ook uit riviere, damme, nat grond en die see.
vlae.rede: The protected wording 'Water verdamp ook uit riviere, damme, nat grond en plante' is not in the lesson: the sentence ends in 'en die see' instead of 'en plante'. This is a content question, not language, so it is left unchanged for the writer or a person to decide.
